data.name: Hidayaat
data.gender_notes: Hidayaat is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: A name derived from the Arabic word ‘hidayah’ which means ‘guidance’ or ‘direction’. This name signifies the provision of guidance and support, especially in spiritual matters. In Islamic tradition, it is believed that Allah (SWT) sends guides and messengers to humanity to lead them towards the right path. The name Hidayaat carries the meaning “Guide, direction” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Hidayaat usually hope their child will grow to embody guide, direction and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A symbol of Allah's guidance in our lives.
data.etymology: Hidayaat belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Guide, direction.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Hidayaat total 6, giving a life-path number of 6. Number 6 is linked with Venus and with the qualities of responsibility, care and community.

in_urdu.name: هدايات
